purpose: Read one real final ERA5 monthly rainfall GRIB with the evaluation decoder before closing v1.0.0. Earlier tests used a synthetic header only.
result: The original time check rejected the real file. The decoder and its synthetic fixture now follow the real header; the same file is accepted and a wrong target month is still rejected.
why_this_month: Already final in November 2026 and outside the forecast plan, so no issued forecast is scored.

request.submitted_through: CDS web form; its request omits the explicit 0.25-degree grid key used by the CLI download

before_fix.assumed: dataDate on the first day of the target month and dataTime 0
before_fix.outcome: rejected: Observation month/time differs from the target.

after_fix.required: stepType avgad; dataDate/dataTime at 18 UTC on the day before the target month; validity at 06 UTC on its first day
after_fix.outcome_target_2026_07: rejected: Observation month/time differs from the target.

limits: One month of one product. October 2026 has not been retrieved or scored, and its file must still pass every check when it becomes eligible.
